name: Operations
description: The day-to-day book-keeping routine for the accountant. Each task links to the matching Accounting SOP with the full step-by-step, journals and gotchas.

items.title: D1 · Tranzact → Tally (split TDS, approve, push)
items.description: Split TDS on every service bill (job work = 2% on value before GST — never save at 0), approve everything pending (documents + TDS journals; fix rejects in Tranzact, never type into Tally by hand), then push all five voucher types one at a time via the Chrome plugin: Sales → Purchase → Credit Note → Debit Note → Journal.
items.notes: Done when Pending = 0 and Approved = 0 on both Document Approval and Journal Entry. ~10 min. Needs Tally open for the plugin to connect.

items.title: D2 · Shopify orders, then Easebuzz payouts
items.description: In the plugin option 3, fetch yesterday's Shopify-Orders first (Platform Type Online-Store), then Easebuzz payouts for the SAME dates (Platform Type Payment-Gateway). Easebuzz runs second because a payout can only clear an order already in Tally.
items.notes: NEVER fetch the same Easebuzz dates twice — a second fetch double-books the payouts. If a day looks short, check the Day Book (voucher type Journal, that date) before re-fetching. ~5 min.

items.title: W1 · Weekly checks (Monday)
items.description: Confirm Tally's top-bar date is today; reconcile last week's Easebuzz payout count/amounts against the Easebuzz dashboard settlement list (no repeats); clear Tranzact rejects; review Suspense.

items.title: M1 · Amazon: import four reports
items.description: Download MTR-B2C, MTR-B2B and STR, request the Settlement (Transaction) report, upload all four on the plugin site, then import into Tally with option 2 one file type at a time. Check Amazon Seller A/c, Amazon Settlement and Amazon Bank end-of-month balances.

items.title: M2 · Shiprocket COD remittances
items.description: Download the COD remittance report, save it unedited as YYYY-MM_Mon_Shiprocket_COD_AWB.xls, upload to File Manager → Custom Uploads, import with option 5, then book every Shiprocket freight invoice (COD + prepaid) and tie out — total booked should equal Total Deductions from COD.

items.title: M3 · Snapmint settlements
items.description: Request the settlement report (arrives by email), save it per the Custom Uploads naming convention, upload to File Manager → Custom Uploads, and import with option 5.

items.title: M4 · Platform invoices + Amazon expense JV
items.description: Book each platform invoice as Purchase-Expense (base → fee ledger, GST → Input GST, credit the platform's control ledger; Amazon ads also carry TDS lines), pass the Amazon expense JV, and match every invoice to GSTR-2B. If an invoice is missing from 2B there is no input credit — tell Hargun.

items.title: M5 · Banks, statutory dates, close
items.description: Import and reconcile the three banks (HDFC, ICICI, Central Bank — Central Bank file needs column headings on row 14); meet the statutory dates (7th TDS paid, 10th GSTR-1 data to the CA, 20th GSTR-3B); then check every clearing ledger is cleared and close.
items.notes: Statutory filings themselves are tracked in the Accounts category; this task is the operating close that feeds them.

items.title: Q · 26Q, Form 16A, Amazon TDS refunds
items.description: File the 26Q TDS return (by 31 Jul / 31 Oct / 31 Jan / 31 May — late filing means Amazon won't refund the TDS on ads), upload Form 16A to Seller Central once generated, and confirm Amazon TDS refunds arrived in settlements (older than 6 months → raise a Seller Central case).
